visualCharacteristics.purpose: lazy-loaded iframe of the Hover home exterior designer (600px tall on mobile, 800px from 1024px) with a centered light footer bar for attribution links; a plain link to the designer shows until the iframe loads
visualCharacteristics.description: 80px padded band, transparent background. Large dark full-width iframe (600px mobile / 800px desktop) (hover.to designer embed-container, colorMode=dark) with a light-grey 56px footer bar carrying a "Hover" logo link (https://hover.to/wr/properties). Visual-tree hint is default-content, but an iframe cannot be authored as default content, so it is mapped to an embed block.

contentPattern.structure: One cell: link to the Hover designer embed-container URL (https://hover.to/designer/embed-container?...). Any additional links (e.g. the Hover attribution link) are rendered in the footer bar. An optional heading sets the iframe title
contentPattern.description: Third-party Hover designer iframe embed (script https://hover.to/designer/embed?version=1.0&key=d229ec07-2822-4bec-93b0-3c815df3beae) with "Hover" attribution link | Large dark 16:9 interactive app iframe loaded via the Hover script, with a light footer bar carrying the Hover attribution link

usage: Use where the Hover designer app is embedded.
reuseGuidance: For generic video or social embeds use the base embed block.
